products.name: BPC-157
products.description: Body-protection compound peptide, lyophilized. Characterized by third-party HPLC and mass spec on every lot.
products.overview:
BPC-157 is one of the most frequently requested reference peptides in the preclinical literature. Each lot is synthesized to order, lyophilized under nitrogen, and released only after third-party analytical review.

Supplied in amber glass vials with crimp seals. Store lyophilized material refrigerated and protected from light.
products.mechanism: In published cell-culture work, BPC-157 has been characterized for its interactions with growth-factor signaling pathways and nitric-oxide-related enzyme systems. All available data are limited to in-vitro and preclinical models.

products.name: TB-500
products.description: Thymosin beta-4 fragment, lyophilized. Third-party analytical testing on every batch.
products.overview: TB-500 is supplied as a lyophilized reference material for in-vitro research. Each batch is released with its analytical documentation attached.
products.mechanism: Characterized in cell-culture models for actin-binding interactions. All available data are limited to in-vitro and preclinical models.

products.name: LEAN Blend
products.description: Multi-compound research blend for in-vitro metabolic-pathway research. Each constituent characterized separately.
products.overview: A combined reference preparation for laboratories comparing multi-analyte characterization workflows. Each constituent's analytical profile is documented on the lot certificate.

products.name: GHK-Cu
products.description: Copper tripeptide complex, lyophilized — the copper chelate gives the cake its blue color.
products.overview: GHK-Cu is supplied as the copper(II) chelate of the tripeptide GHK. The characteristic blue lyophilizate is an identity indicator noted on each certificate.
products.mechanism: Characterized in vitro as a copper-binding tripeptide. All available data are limited to in-vitro and preclinical models.

products.name: Semax
products.description: Heptapeptide ACTH(4-7) analog, lyophilized, for neurochemistry research applications.
products.overview: Semax is supplied lyophilized for in-vitro neurochemistry research. Each lot is characterized before listing.

products.name: Epithalon
products.description: Synthetic tetrapeptide (AEDG), lyophilized, supplied for telomerase research models.
products.overview: Epithalon is supplied as a lyophilized tetrapeptide reference material for in-vitro telomerase research models.
